scientific_integrity: The generating function, Catalan representation, and base valuation identity are explicitly acknowledged as prior work; only the exact tail cutoff, tightness indices and resulting forbidden residues are assessed.
scientific_limitations: Elementary extraction from a previously published Catalan coefficient formula, limited to one avoidance class and 2-powers; no termwise complete valuation theorem; possible unlocated equivalent; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact 2-adic extinction conductor for a permutation-avoidance sequence
